      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .hero__dot.active { background: var(--white); width: 48px; }
    .hero__nav-btns { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .hero__nav-btn {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%;

<script>
  /* ── Hero Carousel ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let currentSlide = 0;
  const totalSlides = 5;
  let heroTimer;

  function goToSlide(index) {
    const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero__slide');
    const texts  = document.querySelectorAll('.hero__slide-text');
    const dots   = document.querySelectorAll('.hero__dot');

    slides[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    slides[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    texts[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    dots[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    dots[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-selected','false');

    currentSlide = (index + totalSlides) % totalSlides;

    slides[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
    slides[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    texts[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
    dots[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
    dots[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-selected','true');

    resetHeroTimer();
  }

  function changeSlide(dir) { goToSlide(currentSlide + dir); }

  function resetHeroTimer() {
    clearInterval(heroTimer);
    heroTimer = setInterval(() => goToSlide(currentSlide + 1), 6000);
  }

  resetHeroTimer();

  // Touch / swipe support for hero
  (function() {
    const hero = document.querySelector('.hero');
    let startX = 0;
    hero.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    hero.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) changeSlide(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});
  })();

  /* ── Team Region Toggle ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  const teamPositions = { na: 0, asia: 0, europe: 0, oceania: 0 };

  function selectRegion(e, region) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.team__tab').forEach(t => {
      t.classList.remove('active');
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.team__region').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));

    e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
    e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
    document.getElementById('region-' + region).classList.add('active');
  }

  function moveTeam(region, dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('track-' + region);
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team__card');
    const cardWidth = 300 + 24; // card width + gap
    const maxPos = Math.max(0, (cards.length - 1) * cardWidth);

    teamPositions[region] = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxPos, teamPositions[region] + dir * cardWidth));
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamPositions[region]}px)`;
  }

  // Touch support for team carousel
  ['na','asia','europe','oceania'].forEach(region => {
    const wrapper = document.querySelector(`#region-${region} .team__track-wrapper`);
    if (!wrapper) return;
    let startX = 0;
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) moveTeam(region, diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});
  });

  /* ── Work Carousel ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let workPos = 0;

  function moveWork(dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('workTrack');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.work__card');
    const cardWidth = 400 + 24;
    const visible = Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth) || 1;
    const maxPos = Math.max(0, (cards.length - visible) * cardWidth);

    workPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxPos, workPos + dir * cardWidth));
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${workPos}px)`;
  }

  // Touch for work carousel
  (function() {
    const wrapper = document.querySelector('.work__track-wrapper');
    let startX = 0;
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) moveWork(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});
  })();

  /* ── Language Dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  function toggleLang() {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('langBtn');
    const menu = document.getElementById('langMenu');
    const open = menu.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  }

  function selectLang(e, lang) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const btn  = document.getElementById('langBtn');
    const menu = document.getElementById('langMenu');

    // Update button text (keep chevron SVGs)
    btn.childNodes.forEach(n => { if (n.nodeType === 3) n.textContent = ' ' + lang + ' '; });
    btn.firstChild.nextSibling.textContent = ' ' + lang + ' ';

    // Simpler: just close the menu
    menu.classList.remove('open');
    btn.classList.remove('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');

    // Update active state
    menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.classList.toggle('active', a.textContent.trim() === lang);
      a.setAttribute('aria-selected', a.textContent.trim() === lang);
    });

    // Update label text node
    const textNode = [...btn.childNodes].find(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
    if (textNode) textNode.textContent = ' ' + lang + ' ';
  }

  // Close dropdown on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const dd = document.querySelector('.lang-dropdown');
    if (!dd.contains(e.target)) {
      document.getElementById('langMenu').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('langBtn').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('langBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    }
  });

  /* ── Cookie Consent ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function acceptCookies() {
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent','accepted');
  }
  function declineCookies() {
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent','declined');
  }
  function manageCookies() {
    alert('Cookie preferences: You can manage your cookie settings here. (In a production site, this would open a detailed preferences modal.)');
  }
  function showCookieBanner(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  // Check prior consent
  if (localStorage.getItem('cookieConsent')) {
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
  }

  /* ── Mobile Navigation ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    menu.classList.toggle('open');
  }
  function closeMobileMenu() {
    document.getElementById('hamburger').classList.remove('open');
    document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.remove('open');
  }

  /* ── Keyboard navigation for hero ──────────────────────────── */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  changeSlide(-1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') changeSlide(1);
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Leap Studio — Your Reinvention and Experience Partner</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    /* ─── Reset & Base ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    :root {
      --bg:        #0A0A0A;
      --bg2:       #111111;
      --bg3:       #1A1A1A;
      --border:    rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      --white:     #FFFFFF;
      --gray:      #808080;
      --gray-light:#AAAAAA;
      --accent:    #3B82F6;   /* electric blue */
      --accent2:   #F59E0B;   /* warm amber */
      --font:      'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --radius:    4px;
      --transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: var(--font); }

    /* ─── Utility ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .container { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 2rem; }
    .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; }
    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 2px;
      color: var(--gray-light);
    }
    .tag--podcast { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
    .tag--article { border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent2); }
    .tag--report  { border-color: #10B981; color: #10B981; }

    /* ─── Buttons ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .btn--primary {
      background: var(--white); color: var(--bg);
    }
    .btn--primary:hover { background: #e5e5e5; }
    .btn--outline {
      border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--white);
    }
    .btn--outline:hover { border-color: var(--white); }
    .btn--accent {
      background: var(--accent); color: var(--white);
    }
    .btn--accent:hover { background: #2563eb; }
    .btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ─── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .nav {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 2rem; height: 64px;
      background: rgba(10,10,10,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__logo {
      font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .nav__logo span { color: var(--accent); }
    .nav__links {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; list-style: none;
    }
    .nav__links a {
      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      color: var(--gray-light);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__links a:hover { color: var(--white); }
    .nav__right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
    .nav__contact {
      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      color: var(--white);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__contact:hover { border-color: var(--white); }

    /* Language dropdown */
    .lang-dropdown { position: relative; }
    .lang-dropdown__btn {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray-light);
      padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .lang-dropdown__btn:hover { color: var(--white); }
    .lang-dropdown__btn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform var(--transition); }
    .lang-dropdown__btn.open svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .lang-dropdown__menu {
      display: none; position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 8px); right: 0;
      min-width: 160px;
      background: var(--bg3);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      z-index: 200;
    }
    .lang-dropdown__menu.open { display: block; }
    .lang-dropdown__menu a {
      display: block; padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--gray-light);
      transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition);
    }
    .lang-dropdown__menu a:hover { background: var(--bg2); color: var(--white); }
    .lang-dropdown__menu a.active { color: var(--white); font-weight: 600; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .nav__hamburger {
      display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
      padding: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav__hamburger span {
      display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--white);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .nav__hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .nav__hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .nav__hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
    .nav__mobile-menu {
      display: none; position: fixed; top: 64px; left: 0; right: 0;
      background: var(--bg2);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      z-index: 99; padding: 1.5rem 2rem 2rem;
    }
    .nav__mobile-menu.open { display: block; }
    .nav__mobile-menu ul { list-style: none; }
    .nav__mobile-menu li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .nav__mobile-menu a {
      display: block; padding: 0.9rem 0;
      font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray-light);
    }

    /* ─── HERO CAROUSEL ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .hero {
      position: relative; min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
      overflow: hidden; padding-top: 64px;
    }
    .hero__slides { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
    .hero__slide {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.9s ease;
    }
    .hero__slide.active { opacity: 1; }
    .hero__slide-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-size: cover; background-position: center;
    }

<script>
  /* ── Hero Carousel ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let currentSlide = 0;
  const totalSlides = 5;
  let heroTimer;

  function goToSlide(index) {
    const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero__slide');
    const texts  = document.querySelectorAll('.hero__slide-text');
    const dots   = document.querySelectorAll('.hero__dot');

    slides[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    slides[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    texts[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    dots[currentSlide].classList.remove('active');
    dots[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-selected','false');

    currentSlide = (index + totalSlides) % totalSlides;

    slides[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
    slides[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    texts[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
    dots[currentSlide].classList.add('active');
    dots[currentSlide].setAttribute('aria-selected','true');

    resetHeroTimer();
  }

  function changeSlide(dir) { goToSlide(currentSlide + dir); }

  function resetHeroTimer() {
    clearInterval(heroTimer);
    heroTimer = setInterval(() => goToSlide(currentSlide + 1), 6000);
  }

  resetHeroTimer();

  // Touch / swipe support for hero
  (function() {
    const hero = document.querySelector('.hero');
    let startX = 0;
    hero.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    hero.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) changeSlide(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});
  })();

  /* ── Team Region Toggle ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  const teamPositions = { na: 0, asia: 0, europe: 0, oceania: 0 };

  function selectRegion(e, region) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.team__tab').forEach(t => {
      t.classList.remove('active');
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.team__region').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('active'));

    e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
    e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
    document.getElementById('region-' + region).classList.add('active');
  }

  function moveTeam(region, dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('track-' + region);
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.team__card');
    const cardWidth = 300 + 24; // card width + gap
    const maxPos = Math.max(0, (cards.length - 1) * cardWidth);

    teamPositions[region] = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxPos, teamPositions[region] + dir * cardWidth));
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${teamPositions[region]}px)`;
  }

  // Touch support for team carousel
  ['na','asia','europe','oceania'].forEach(region => {
    const wrapper = document.querySelector(`#region-${region} .team__track-wrapper`);
    if (!wrapper) return;
    let startX = 0;
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) moveTeam(region, diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});
  });

  /* ── Work Carousel ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let workPos = 0;

  function moveWork(dir) {
    const track = document.getElementById('workTrack');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.work__card');
    const cardWidth = 400 + 24;
    const visible = Math.floor(track.parentElement.offsetWidth / cardWidth) || 1;
    const maxPos = Math.max(0, (cards.length - visible) * cardWidth);

    workPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxPos, workPos + dir * cardWidth));
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${workPos}px)`;
  }

  // Touch for work carousel
  (function() {
    const wrapper = document.querySelector('.work__track-wrapper');
    let startX = 0;
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive:true});
    wrapper.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
      const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) moveWork(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
    }, {passive:true});
  })();

  /* ── Language Dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  function toggleLang() {
    const btn  = document.getElementById('langBtn');
    const menu = document.getElementById('langMenu');
    const open = menu.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  }

  function selectLang(e, lang) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const btn  = document.getElementById('langBtn');
    const menu = document.getElementById('langMenu');

    // Update button text (keep chevron SVGs)
    btn.childNodes.forEach(n => { if (n.nodeType === 3) n.textContent = ' ' + lang + ' '; });
    btn.firstChild.nextSibling.textContent = ' ' + lang + ' ';

    // Simpler: just close the menu
    menu.classList.remove('open');
    btn.classList.remove('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');

    // Update active state
    menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => {
      a.classList.toggle('active', a.textContent.trim() === lang);
      a.setAttribute('aria-selected', a.textContent.trim() === lang);
    });

    // Update label text node
    const textNode = [...btn.childNodes].find(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
    if (textNode) textNode.textContent = ' ' + lang + ' ';
  }

  // Close dropdown on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const dd = document.querySelector('.lang-dropdown');
    if (!dd.contains(e.target)) {
      document.getElementById('langMenu').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('langBtn').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('langBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    }
  });

  /* ── Cookie Consent ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function acceptCookies() {
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent','accepted');
  }
  function declineCookies() {
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
    localStorage.setItem('cookieConsent','declined');
  }
  function manageCookies() {
    alert('Cookie preferences: You can manage your cookie settings here. (In a production site, this would open a detailed preferences modal.)');
  }
  function showCookieBanner(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  // Check prior consent
  if (localStorage.getItem('cookieConsent')) {
    document.getElementById('cookieBanner').classList.add('hidden');
  }

  /* ── Mobile Navigation ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  function toggleMobileMenu() {
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
    hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    menu.classList.toggle('open');
  }
  function closeMobileMenu() {
    document.getElementById('hamburger').classList.remove('open');
    document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.remove('open');
  }

  /* ── Keyboard navigation for hero ──────────────────────────── */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  changeSlide(-1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') changeSlide(1);
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>

`/app/output/index.html` is built — 1,551 lines, 75 KB, no build step required. Here's what's implemented:

**All 6 interactions from `task_input.json`:**
- **Hero carousel** — 5 slides auto-advance every 6s, dot indicators, prev/next buttons, keyboard arrow support, touch swipe
- **Team region toggle** — 4 tabs (North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania) filter to their respective cards with ARIA roles
- **Team member carousel** — per-region prev/next nav + touch swipe, each card has photo placeholder, quote, title, office, CTA
- **Work carousel** — horizontal scroll through 8 case studies, touch-swipe enabled
- **Language dropdown** — toggles Global EN / France FR / China CN, closes on outside click
- **Cookie consent** — Accept All / Decline All / Manage Settings, persists to `localStorage`, re-openable from footer Cookie Settings link

**All 8 sections in order:** hero → team → work → CTA banner → how we work → insights → principles → footer

**Design:** `#0A0A0A` base, electric blue `#3B82F6` accent, Inter typeface via Google Fonts, cinematic gradient thumbnails, generous whitespace, WCAG-compliant contrast, fully responsive with mobile hamburger menu.
